copy.lostFound.title: Lost & found
copy.lostFound.intro: Tell us what you lost or found. Tournament staff will help connect it with its owner.
copy.lostFound.privacyTitle: A private report, not a public listing
copy.lostFound.privacy: Only authorized tournament staff can see your report and contact details. We ask for an email so staff can follow up; your name is optional. Reports are not published on this website or in its public content files.
copy.lostFound.safety: Do not include passwords, ID numbers, or other sensitive details. Keep found items safe and ask a volunteer where to hand them in. For urgent or safety concerns, speak to staff in person.
copy.lostFound.descriptionHint: Include the color, brand, and a distinguishing feature. 5–2000 characters.
copy.lostFound.locationLabel: Where was it lost or found?
copy.lostFound.locationHint: A building, room, or nearby landmark. Write Unknown if you are unsure.
copy.lostFound.timeLabel: When was it lost or found?
copy.lostFound.timeHint: An approximate time is fine, for example November 14, around 10 am Pacific.
copy.lostFound.emailHint: Use an address you can check. A parent or guardian’s email is welcome.
copy.lostFound.successTitle: Your report is with tournament staff
copy.lostFound.successBody: Save your receipt below if you need to speak with staff. They can follow up at the email you provided. This is not a promise of a match or an email notification, and the receipt does not let anyone view your report online.

guide.title: Your BMT visitor guide
guide.intro: A place to prepare for November 14, 2026 and find help during the day.
guide.notice: Demo guide · November event details, contacts, Wi-Fi and room assignments have not been confirmed. This is not an official day-of instruction sheet.

sections.title: Before you arrive
sections.markdown:
BMT is scheduled for **November 14, 2026**. This demo does not publish a check-in time or location.

- Check [Today](/#today) for the latest event notice.
- Use the [schedule](/#schedule) once the organizers publish it.
- Plan your journey with [TakeTransit](https://taketransit.berkeley.mt/); this guide does not duplicate transit directions.

sections.title: Finding your room
sections.markdown:
Use the campus map for orientation, then check your room assignment with the organizers. **The demo does not establish an official room assignment.**

If a floor, entrance or accessible route is not verified, ask a staff member rather than guessing. Campus map information and tournament assignments are different things.
sections.imageAlt: Campus orientation map; not a confirmed November tournament room map

sections.title: During the day
sections.markdown:
Check [live updates](/#updates) for organizer announcements and schedule changes. A scheduled start is not a signal to begin a round: follow your proctor’s instructions.

Keep personal belongings with you. If you find or lose an item, use the public help tools or ask staff. Do not post personal contact details in a public description.

sections.title: Accessibility and help
sections.markdown:
**Demo information only:** accessible entrances, restroom locations, Wi-Fi access and the information desk are awaiting organizer confirmation.

Ask staff for assistance if a route or instruction is unclear. For an immediate emergency, contact local emergency services; do not wait for an online message to be read.

help.title: Urgent help
help.markdown: For an immediate emergency, contact local emergency services. The online inbox is not monitored as an emergency service. Event-specific contacts are not yet confirmed.

help.title: Wi-Fi
help.markdown: Demo: the November guest network and access instructions have not been confirmed. Ask staff for the current instructions. Never publish private network passwords here.

help.title: Information desk
help.markdown: Demo: the information desk location and opening times are awaiting confirmation. Ask an event staff member for help.

help.title: Restrooms
help.markdown: Demo: restroom locations and accessible facilities are awaiting verification. Ask staff or follow posted building signs.

help.title: Questions or lost items
help.markdown: Use the public help tools or ask staff. Do not include sensitive personal details in public reports. A staff reply is not guaranteed to be immediate.
